blocks.text: Percentile woh qeemat hai jis se neeche mushahidat ka diya gaya feesad aata hai. 25th percentile pehla quartile (Q1), 50th percentile median, aur 75th percentile teesra quartile (Q3) hai. Percentiles hayati data ki taqseem samajhne mein madad dete hain, chahe tirchhi (skewed) ho ya normal.

Pth percentile ka rank R = (P / 100) x (n + 1) hai, jahan n mushahidat ki tadaad hai. Agar R poora adad ho to percentile tarteeb wale data mein usi jagah ki qeemat hai; warna do qareebi ranks ke darmiyan interpolation karein. R = 4.4 ke liye: qeemat = chauthi qeemat + 0.4 x (paanchwi qeemat - chauthi qeemat).

10 logon ki unchaiyan (cm): 160, 162, 168, 165, 170, 175, 172, 178, 180, 182. 40th percentile ke liye: tarteeb, 160, 162, 165, 168, 170, 172, 175, 178, 180, 182; n = 10; R = 40 / 100 x (10 + 1) = 4.4, chauthi (168) aur paanchwi (170) qeemat ke darmiyan. Percentile = 168 + 0.4 x (170 - 168) = 168 + 0.8 = 168.8 cm, yaani 40% mushahidat 168.8 cm ya us se kam hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa percentile median hai, aur Q1 aur Q3 kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Median 50th percentile hai; Q1 25th aur Q3 75th percentile hai.

items: R = (P / 100) x (n + 1); R poora na ho to interpolation.
